hero.title: Multimedia projects. Using teamwork. Lots of fun.
hero.subtitle: Conjure is ÉTS's interactive media lab: a student club where we code, draw, and playtest games from prototype to playable demo.

mission.title: A club, a room, a community of creators
mission.text: Conjure brings together students from every ÉTS program around a shared goal: learning to make video games as a team, backed by a dedicated room, training, and an active network in the industry.

offerings.title: Everything you need to make your first game

activities.title: Gamelab, game jams, and an annual gala
activities.description: From training to competition, all the way to presenting your work to the industry.

cta.title: Want to make your first game with us?
cta.text: Join the Discord, come by the room, and jump on your next project with the team.
